title: TriplyTripPlanGeneration
TriplyTripPlanGeneration
description: Structured output Gemini must return for one AI generation attempt. Supports both Trip.planning_mode values: DESTINATION_FIRST (user picked a destination + budget -> exactly 1 destination_option expected) and BUDGET_FIRST (user gave only a budget -> 1-3 candidate destination_options, each within budget, for the user to choose from). No pricing fields are requested from the model: every cost figure is looked up server-side from Place.reference_price and never trusted from the LLM.

planning_mode.description: Echo of Trip.planning_mode as sent in the prompt context. Sanity check before any DB write.

destination_options.description: DESTINATION_FIRST: exactly 1 entry, for the destination the user already chose. BUDGET_FIRST: 1-3 candidate destinations (only from the supported destination list given in context), each a complete, self-contained plan that fits the user's stated budget. The user picks one afterwards.

destination_name.description: Must exactly match a Destination.name from the supported destination list given in the prompt context.

accommodation.description: Exactly one hotel/accommodation for the whole stay in this destination. Do NOT also list an ACCOMMODATION-category place inside 'days' -- it belongs only here, since a hotel is booked for the full trip, not a single day/time_slot.

days.description: One entry per day of the trip, in order, covering the full requested duration.

place_name.description: Must exactly match a Place.name whose category is ACCOMMODATION (Hotel), from the supplied Place list for this destination.

nights.description: Number of nights booked. Backend multiplies this by Place.reference_price (which is a per-night rate) to get the total accommodation cost -- never ask the model to do this math.

day_number.description: 1-based sequential day number. Maps to ItineraryDay.day_number.

date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) for this day. Maps to ItineraryDay.date.

items.description: Non-accommodation entries for this day (restaurants, attractions, activities, transport). Must include at least one RESTAURANT-category place for the day (a meal), and the plan as a whole (across all days) must include at least one TRANSPORT-category place (e.g. an airport transfer or a transport pass).

time_slot.description: Maps to ItineraryItem.time_slot (DB CHECK constraint allows only these 3 values).

order_index.description: Order of this item within its time_slot, starting at 1. Maps to ItineraryItem.order_index.

place_name.description: Maps to ItineraryItem.place_id (resolved server-side by name lookup). MUST be an exact, character-for-character match of a 'name' value from the Place list supplied in the prompt context for this destination -- and must NOT be an ACCOMMODATION-category place (see 'accommodation'). Never invent a place not in that list (FR-AI-002 -- 0% invented places).

notes.description: Optional short, user-facing note (e.g. why this fits the traveler's interests or budget tier). Maps to ItineraryItem.notes. Omit or null if nothing useful to add.
